hypothesis: Can causal funding forecasts and cost-aware entry/exit hysteresis improve spot-perpetual cash-and-carry excess returns versus always-on hedged carry?
data: Official Binance monthly 1h spot, perpetual execution and mark-price klines plus actual funding events; Jan2020-Aug2026. Spot archive changes ms to us in2025 handled explicitly.

periods.formation: 2020 onward; ML quarterly trailing730days, minimum300 labelled observations pooled across two assets

position: Buy spot and short exactly the same underlying quantity in linear USDT perpetuals. Target20% NAV spot notional per asset, plus fully reserved futures collateral; gross intended <=80% NAV across both pairs. Weekly delta-quantity rebalancing, not full turnover. An hourly observed gross exposure above95% NAV schedules a resize at the following open.
forecast: Next30calendar-day annualised sum of funding. EWMA uses conservative min7day,30day past annualised funding. Ridge(alpha=10) uses current rate,7/30day averages, prior-hour basis, lagged1/7day returns and7day volatility; scaler fit only on training; labels ending >=fit cutoff are purged.
entry: 30day predicted funding + current basis >roundtrip fees + 2*cash opportunity rate*30/365 +2% annual risk buffer*30/365; basis>-25bp. Forecast rate clipped[-100%,100%] annually. No short-spot/reverse carry.
exit: Forecast falls below2*cash rate-1% for3daily decisions, or basis<-1%, or margin safety rule. No hold-period tuning. Forecast/gates frozen before validation.
execution: Decisions00UTC using completed prior-hour bars and funding known at least1hour earlier. Orders execute01UTC. Funding applied to positions held before event, with actual rate and contemporaneous mark. Millisecond jitter mapped to scheduled funding hour; rate not available to trade at that event.
costs: Base spot12bps (10fee+2slippage), futures7bps (5fee+2slippage), each one-way notional; stress20/12 and30/20bps. No fee discounts/rebates. Charge all resizing and closure legs. Cost stresses keep the entry gate at base12/7bps; stress changes charged costs, not the decision thresholds.
cash: NYFedSOFR minus25bp, floor0, available7calendar days after effective date; ACT360 accrual. Off-exchange free cash only, same proxy as benchmark; reserved margin no interest. Assumed cash-investment return, not actual fund total return.
risk: Assess hourly mark-high collateral stress; minimum cash/short-notional stress ratio10%. Any possible breach invalidates a liquidation-safe claim. No favourable intrabar fills. Actual order-book spreads, outages, transfer delays and ADL unavailable.
selection: No selecting asset/universe/parameters based on locked returns; choose adaptive model only from2022 validation, and report all3 in later comparison. If validation offers no supported improvement, retain always-on benchmark and say so.
report: Annual returns/excess Sharpe, drawdowns, PnL decomposition funding/basis/cash/fees, turnover, calendar regimes, crisis periods, exposure, margin stress, cost stress, leave-one-asset-out and block bootstrap.
data_quality: Official daily archives recover missing monthly mark bars. There are31 unavailable spot-print hours per asset across2020-Aug2026. Those hours use an explicitly flagged prior spot/mark ratio times current mark solely for inventory valuation, and cannot execute. A composite-index archive was unavailable. Proxy sensitivity must be reported.
cost_gate_stress: Decision gate stays at base12/7bp costs in all stress runs.

collateral_accounting_correction.reason: Pre-lock accounting audit: one-times margin equity requires reserving additional physical cash for unrealised short losses. Those losses cannot be left in interest-earning bank cash.
collateral_accounting_correction.implementation: At inventory changes, posted reserve = current short notional + negative unrealised PnL; top up at daily decisions; no interest on posted reserves. Assert that cash funds all reserves. Positive unrealised PnL is never credited as interest-earning cash.

cash_realisation: If a large spot decline leaves offsetting futures profits unrealised and cash insufficient to fund the declared collateral/spot resize, realise futures gains through a close/reopen at the execution price, charging both futures-leg fees. No free credit of unrealised gains.

cash_proxy_revision.reason: Daily FamaFrenchRF rounded0.01percentagepoint creates coarse252xannual yield steps. Replace cash proxy uniformly with official NYFedSOFR, seven calendar-day information lag and25bp cash management spread (floor0), actual360 converted to365 equivalent. No asset, forecast, thresholds or model reselection. All strategies and stress cases rerun.
cash_proxy_revision.status: Sensitivity/accounting refinement after historical results were seen. Later evaluation remains retrospective, not pristine unseen test.

cash_proxy: NYFedSOFR minus25bp, floor0, available7calendar days after effective date; ACT360 accrual. Off-exchange free cash only, same proxy as benchmark; reserved margin no interest. Assumed cash-investment return, not actual fund total return.
missing_print_signal_guard: Flagged spot valuation proxies cannot create daily entry decisions. Funding forecast training features require a fully observed169-hour price window; proxy-based price features are excluded. Applied uniformly after preliminary results, without parameter or asset selection.
